emergenz.delta: Separate macro/Assembly discovery from causal evaluation. Require frozen macro identity or nested discovery/evaluation split, multiplicity/null controls, matched micro/pairwise baselines and separately inspectable causal evidence dimensions.
emergenz.next_test: H1 held-out intervention battery with null/permutation macro search.

gwt.delta: Workspace/re-entry metrics may nominate macro candidates but cannot self-certify emergence. Bind GWT episodes to frozen macro definitions and held-out intervention receipts.
gwt.next_test: Compare truthful/shuffled/no re-entry after macro definitions are frozen; keep recurrence and emergence distinct.

hyperposition.delta: Higher-order relation discovery must be evaluated against the best matched pairwise/state-machine reduction on independent interventions; candidate topology search itself is not evidence.
hyperposition.next_test: Held-out n-ary vs pairwise intervention response and OOD transfer.

claygraph.delta: ClayGraph may generate/represent candidate macroscales but graph activation/selection cannot count as their causal validation. Persist macro_definition_hash and discovery lineage.
claygraph.next_test: Dynamic H1 graph traces with frozen candidate hashes and topology shuffle controls.

unifieddb.delta: Persist discovery/evaluation partition identities, candidate count, null family, macro definition hash, estimator version and all intervention receipts to make selection bias auditable.
unifieddb.next_test: Replay/query contract for nested macro discovery/evaluation without cross-split leakage.

claycode.delta: Current generic record/rule semantics appear sufficient for MacroDefinition, EmergenceEvaluationSplit and EmergenceClaimReceipt as a library/schema candidate; no core semantic change justified yet.
claycode.next_test: Parse/canonicalize/type/effect/compile on Ubuntu; only executable failure can justify language redesign.

frank.delta: FRANK self-observation may read bounded emergence receipts, but no Assembly/workspace/loop may label itself emergent merely because it was selected or compressed well. Evidence remains external/replayable.
frank.next_test: H1 instrumentation with frozen macro identities and model-readable projection separated from estimator authority.

harness.delta: Add nested macro-discovery/evaluation experiment: search candidate Assemblies/macrostates only on discovery traces, freeze definitions, evaluate on held-out matched interventions; include null Y-independent search, common-driver injection, lesion/rescue, re-entry shuffle, pairwise reduction and OOD transfer.
harness.next_test: Execute on Ubuntu H1 once stage permits; synthetic results are not release evidence.

clayresearch.delta: Treat abstraction-selection bias as an anti-Goodhart axis for emergence research. Do not optimize EI/synergy/causal-primitives on the same traces used to choose the macro representation without nested controls.
clayresearch.next_test: Fuse with Safe-Effect and loop-control work; test whether a smaller evidence ladder preserves discrimination.

infrastructure_finding.finding: Interconnect preflight now uses clayresearch, while ROOM_REGISTRY.json still exposes legacy clay room/trigger naming.
